phase3_findings.description: Trailing 's' unit not anchored by the assertion glob '*"run-parallel: elapsed "[0-9]*'; a malformed emission like 'elapsed 5x' would still pass. Test-tightness only, not a live defect (producer always emits %ss). Already raised by the blinded shadow — prior art, non-blocking.

Sub-second 'elapsed 0s' lower bound not pinned by a dedicated test. Not an actual coverage hole: the [0-9] glob already accepts '0', so a sub-second run passes the existing clean-path assertion. Documents intent only. Already raised by the blinded shadow — prior art, non-blocking.
phase3_findings.fix_decision: not-blocking (already-considered shadow observation; no real regression uncaught)

phase3_findings.description: The two new stdout-only assertions each re-run the whole coordinator a second time (PSR_FAIL_OUT, PSR_CLEAN_OUT) rather than reusing existing 2>&1 captures, doubling two coordinator launches in the module. Reviewer judged this a justified tradeoff (stdout-vs-stderr distinction is required by AC1/AC3 and cannot be proven from a combined capture) — correct as written, no change required.
